name: Bhelpuri
ingredients_raw: Puffed Rice (16%), Refined Palmolein Oil, Split Pulse Bengal Gram (Chana dal) (10%), Groundnut (Peanuts) (8%), Bengal Gram Flour (Besan) (8%), Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) (8%), Rice Flakes (4%), Whole Bengal Gram Flakes (3%), Iodised Salt, Turmeric, Cumin, Coriander Powder, Curry Leaves, Red Chilli, Black Salt, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Dried Ginger Powder, Black Pepper, Ajowan, Cardamom, Clove, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Bay Leaf & Asafoetida
